description: ragdoll on death scriptand i'm back 4 more cool stuffpros:* does not have a hard-coded ragdoll appearance(meaning that you can apply player accessories, etc!)* it acts like a player and looks like a player, physics objects are parented to the character* should work with native retrostudio(hopefully, haven't tested all versions)* should be pretty easy to modify the physics rigcons:* the character model must be parented into workspace so its joints will be created* the whole code is kind of a hack, reinserting humanoids, parenting stuff to lighting, etc...* doesn't work for npcs* not fully testedhow it works:* when you die, create a model containing the player's limbs, etc..* i create a hinge rig so rotates exist* i then slap on welds for the parts on the hinge rig to the character rig* i made a humanoidrootpart in the character so the camera follows* i put on a humanoid for the character rig and the player's true character so they don't break their joints   immediatelyhow to setup:* parent ragdoll into starterpack* parent character into workspacehow does the physics rig work?* there are hinge objects that create rotates(which was a method used to create ragdolls back then)* colliders allows the character to hit objects, you can change their position and sizes and it will change the way the ragdoll moves.

description: really wip animation scriptnote that this is buggy, and is kind of a messbut this has full on matrix interpolation and keyframe stuff, and runs on the client's renderstep so its really smoothanimating:* you must start out with the original sample example model[you can just make your own if you want to, but thats kind of a hassle].* there is no way to center animations yet, so you must center the model to 0,0,0[which is an issue that i will address in the future]* use an intvalue per keyframe as that will be the way the keyframe will be looked up* each animation must need a Config configuration and has string values indicating the part's name, and the value represents the motor affected[doesn't respect child bone stuff yet]* every animation must be a model w/ a name that will be referred to when running an animation, default is always reserved to reset the current animationhow to run:* on the client, set the value of the Anim stringvalue in the character* on the server, fire all clients in character.Animation where the first argument is the animation namehow to setup: * AnimServer in workspace[this allows keyframes to be ran in the animation], * AnimHandler in Lighting[this handles all of the animations]* Animation in StarterPack[this handles client replication of animations]* Giver in StarterGui[this gives players an instance of animation handler]* make a model in Lighting called Animations

description: youtob23's Animation PlayerTo make a character play an animation, Fire the remote event "game.Lighting.Anim" on all clients w/ the object character, and the name of the animation you want it to play.Provided are two examples for animations for use and experimentation, those being the 8bit sword's slash, and the monster mash dance.all animations are found in the game.Lighting.Animations folder and follow the structure in the image below.When making animations please note that all body parts that are going to be used in the animation need to be put in the first keyFrame of the animation, and after that need to appear only in the keyFrames before and during the movement ex:  keyframe 0 has left arm and left leg, but keyframe 1 only moves the Left Arm.When making animations keep in mind that the cframe generated from the position and orientation makes a weld that only changes C0, not C1Have fun and feel free to dm me if you have any bugs, issues, or questions.Edit 7/15: changed wait block to 0.03 seconds to compensate for script speed increase

description: `ATM/Bartender Job/Money Wiring System`This also comes with a GUI for Cash & Bank Amount, and a Leaderstat script already inside.Place everything in their corresponding services and ungroup the model.**DO NOT ungroup the actual stuff themselves, only the models named after services once they're in the corresponding service.**The ATM works as it should, place your card inside, the player can deposit or withdraw, and can return their card if they do not want to make a transaction.The Money Wiring System requires you to get the player's card number (bottom left corner, its going to be a randomly generated number on the GUI under your Bank and Cash amount.) in order to make a transaction. You must have money in your bank in order to wire someone money. Enter their card number, then the amount you want to give the player, then make the transaction. There are many fail-safe systems implemented into this, you cannot enter a random number, you cannot wire money to yourself, and you cannot give someone money if you don't have the sufficient funds in your bank.The bartender job allows any player to click on the NPC's cups, and after a random amount of time, they'll give the player money. After the player takes the money, after a randomly generated wait time, the cups will go back to normal and you can repeat the process again. **Only the player who filled the cup can take the money. **`Feel free to DM me if there are any issues with the model. If you want to edit the scripts, you must have some experience in scripting/block scripting in order to know what you're doing, I don't have anything in the scripts that will hold your hand.`

This will allow you to use the Admin Meter, which when full, allows you to unleash more power!**Are there any plans to make this into the actual Ban Hammer?**Not as of now, but maybe when RetroStudio adds more blocks that can work with the Ban Hammer(or maybe when I learn how to code better:trol: )**Can I modify this free model into my own gear?**Well, it isn't a free model for nothing. creator: mjdxp
description: **Better Rocket LauncherRecently, the RetroStudio devs converted the Rocket Launcher to block coding (please please PLEASE do this for the other brickbattle tools!!!), so I decided to modify it so it had variables similarly to the Linked Sword and Paintball Gun, making it easier and more user friendly for developers. This is my first major scripting project, so please report any bugs! Included settings are: - ReloadTime (the time you have to wait before using it again)- RocketSize (the size of the rocket part)- RocketColor (the color of the rocket if team colors are disabled or you're not on a team)- RocketSpeed (The velocity of the rocket projectile)- FollowTeamColor (Determines whether or not the rocket is your team's color)- ExpireTime (The time the rocket will stay loaded before automatically detonating)- DestroyJointRadiusPercent (The radius which the blast will destroy joints)- BlastRadius (The radius of the explosion)The default settings are the same as the vanilla rocket launcher.If anyone has any additional feature ideas, bug fixes, or feedback, let me know. creator: mjdxp
description: **Better SuperBallMore brickbattle tools have been converted to block coding! As with my Better Rocket Launcher, this version of the SuperBall adds a bunch of settings in order to make customizing it a lot easier. There is a strange bug where the console says that the Wait1 block in the CannonBall script isn't a number, however it is and it works as inteded otherwise. If anyone finds a way to fix this, let me know. This model is freely available and can be used or modified without any credit.Here is a list of added settings (ReloadTime, Velocity, MaxDamage, and AllowTeamKilling were already there):- CannonBallSize - The size of the projectile.- CannonBallReflect - The reflection of the projectile.- RandomColor - Determines whether the projectile is a random color. Has priority over CannonBallColor and FollowTeamColor.- CannonBallColor - The color of the projectile. RandomColor and FollowTeamColor must be off for this to work.- FollowTeamColor - Determines whether the projectile should be the player's team color. Has priority over CannonBallColor. RandomColor must be off for this to work.- DespawnTime - The amount of time that will pass until a projectile despawns.- DamageReduction (Advanced) - Every time the SuperBall bounces, the initial damage value will be divided by this number. For example, with a DamageReduction value of 2, the damage value will be halved each time it bounces off a wall or player.- DisableThreshold (Advanced) - When the damage being done by the SuperBall is less than this number, it will become "disabled" and it will not deal damage anymore.The default settings are the same as the vanilla SuperBall.If anyone has any additional feature ideas, bug fixes, or feedback, let me know. Thank you to the RetroStudio developers for converting a bunch of the brickbattle tools a day after my Better Rocket Launcher was released (I guess it worked, lol), and thank you for everyone's support for my Better Rocket Launcher tool.

creator: mjdxp
description: **mjdxp's Ultimate Fire System** (1/2)I have created a system which allows for creation and removal of fire using a fire setter and a fire extinguisher. The concept is an antagonistic player can set objects on fire, and other players can use fire extinguishers to put out the fires.**Fire StickThis tool allows the player to set parts named "BurnablePart" on fire. The fire will shrink over time, eventually despawning after 90 seconds. When a part is on fire, it will slowly damage any player which touches it. If a player is wearing a certain clothing item (http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id by default, this can be changed in KillBrickScriptFire's If3 block), they will be immune to fire. This can be used to make fireproof suits for a firefighter class. Each BurnablePart should have no more than one child in it, any more will prevent it from being set on fire. Fires created with the fire stick can be extinguished by the fire extinguisher.(part 1/2 because the message is too long)

creator: mjdxp
description: **mjdxp's Ultimate Fire System** (2/2)**Fire ExtinguisherThis is a modified slingshot which will remove fires when its pellets make contact with a part on fire. More specifically, they will remove any object named "RemFire" or "KillBrickScriptFire". This is to allow for fire or kill brick scripts in your game which can't be removed with the fire extinguisher. Note that I made a fire extinguisher free model a few weeks ago, however it removes all fires and objects named "KillBrickScriptFire", making it less ideal for games which have fires that shouldn't be removable.Both models are free and open source. You may modify, distribute, and view the code in any way you like. If any problems come up, let me know so I can fix them. I may create a new version of the Fire Stick to make it easier to modify by adding value variables so people do not have to go through my messy block code to change things.Thank you to @Nilivh  for helping me beta test and finding some problems. Thank you to the developers for Pinewood Computer Core for creating the fire system which this is heavily inspired by. Finally, thank you for supporting my free models. If you use this or any of my other models in a game, let me know so I can check it out!

creator: kabook
description: OK TAKE TWOvery basic tower defense base, enemies are created by calling BindableEvent *createEnemy* with the Name of their given Folder in the *enemies* folder. enemies move from node to node until they reach the end, at which point they stop moving and fire a BindableEvent *reachedEnd*, then die 5 seconds later. uses custom Health and health gui to reduce lag from Humanoids. call BindableEvent *dealDamage* in the model with first value equal to damage to deal damage. -the nodes are numbered from 0 - # of nodes, the folder for Nodes will be under workspace.Map.Nodes-units can have values changed by calling changeProperty in the model, first argument equal to the name of the Property to change, the second argument equal to a tuple for whichever value you're changing, and third argument is a boolean which says whether to (IF TRUE) add the second argument to the current value of the property, or (IF FALSE) to just set it to the number value.-currently have to use a while loop to logic through whether units need to change Node or not. this could realistically be changed somehow if PropertyChanged starts working, or parts could be lerped between points. unsure if that's any more efficient though

description: Gamepasses in RetroStudio (concept)***Ever wanted gamepasses in your RetroStudio game but are tired of developers not adding that? Well, my script does exactly that!*This is a mockup service, that uses a leaderstat to mimic Retrobux. There are 3 bindable events in it: PromptPlayer, PurchaseSuccessful and PurchaseFailed. Fire the first one with the player USERNAME and the gamepass ID as the arguments to prompt a player to purchase a gamepass, and the other 2 will fire themselves based on the success of purchase. **To set up your own gamepass go to the Data > Gamepasses folder and copy any example one. To check if a user owns a gamepass load a key "(username)(gamepass name)" from datastore, it should be true or false/nil.**There are also 4 demo buttons to play around with.

description: **Lakodex's TagHider**ModelEver found it a lost cause for *RetroStudio*™️ Developers to add a sort of way to Disable, and enable the players name tag? Introducing TagHider™️!TagHider™️ will **automatically** attach to players characters and allowing you to toggle the Nametag without making the head invisible.*Some Uses:*Hide and SeekFreeze TagFPS GamesFNAF (animatronics vs guard) Games.*How to use with my own scripts?*All TagHider does is create a Fakehead, and moves a BoolValue in to the Humanoid named "TagVisible". Use FindFirstChild before trying to set TagVisible's Value. Set this to True to make the tag visible. description: **FauxTracker (Early GUI) + FauxMIDI Player**For the first time in ~~2b2t~~ RetroStudio history, ~~slave labor~~ a fake midi player/maker for your classic audio needs! No longer are you stuck with roblox's public audio catalog/retrostudio allowed music! You are free to make your own!**FauxMIDI Player**FauxTrackersplit IDs to make it easier to replace shez**Tips**: Songs created by the tracker, as well as songs that the player handles are stored under game.Lighting.FauxMIDI Stored.Songs.Currently the GUI provides no interface for making instruments or adjusting speed (tempo), nor is there a delete capability for tracks/notes, that will have to be done manually for now.There is a demo "song" provided to show the proper layout of a song, as well as a sample instrumentEach "track" is a position in the song, which can have multiple notesThe >'s takes the input of the textbox and finds the corresponding song/track/note, updating all of the values below it, and the < sets the note valuesYou can adjust the current position the song is playing by locally changing the value of the TimePosition object (game.Players.LocalPlayer.FauxMIDI_plr.TimePosition)You can adjust the volume per client using the ClientVolume object (game.Players.LocalPlayer.FauxMIDI_plr.ClientVolume)**Note**: There are three RemoteEvents to control the MIDI Player: ChangeState, LoadSong and LoopState. These can be specifically configured per user, or globally.When the length of a note is set to 0, it'll play the note in full at least once, even if set to loop. The duration is in seconds when set otherwiseValid states are 0-3, those being:0 - Stopped1 - Play2 - Pause3 - Clear (Removes song from ActiveSong, sets TimePosition to 0 and resets to Stopped)Here are some instruments I pulled from gamehero's MIDI Playerhttps://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vSwllEdHNm44WmQLIC5eexX4nOa6VYccStuJXyksnDa2-BDW5RAa4EfbA5e9rUjS7xdysmg9cgdIuCj/pubhtml

description: **Code Input DoorThis is a door which only opens when you enter the correct code. The code can be changed to whatever you'd like. There is also a display which tells you what has been entered already, as well as a clear button.Please note: There are a couple of limitations with the codes you can set. The code must be a valid positive signed integer, which basically just means your code has to be less than around 9223372036854775807. If a number larger than this is inputted into the door, it won't be handled properly. This is a limitation of Roblox's maximum integer size. Additionally, your code cannot start with 0.The default code is 5334118 (if you get the reference, you are very cool!). You can change the code to whatever you'd like by changing the value of the CorrectCode value. You can also change the amount of time the door will stay open by changing the DoorOpenTime value. Don't mess with any other values inside the InputPanel group though, as they will break the door! You can also change the sounds the door plays by changing the sounds under the 5 key, which is located under InputPanel.I apologize for my somewhat messy, uncommented code. It's pretty complicated, involving a lot of different scripts reading different values in order to function. I also was fighting the Roblox chat filter the whole time, so some things might be named strangely. I might try to add some documentation later on. Feel free to (attempt) to mess with the code, maybe you can make it less messy!If you think this is cool, please consider reacting with :Retweet: to help get this on the starboard! I put a *lot* of effort into this, so I hope you enjoy using it! Let me know if you need any help or if I messed something up.

description: **1337 Advanced Admin Gui** ( Took me 5 days help)The Admin Gui has 23 default command but you can easily add more commands for you games like Ban.**How To Add Your Own Command**https://discord.com/channels/645632117455323136/1081243511858397264/10812436346843996561. Go to "Lighting" and copy the "Test" StringValue. Now put it in "Commands" in Lighting. After that change the name to what ever your command is called (ex. Ban) and change the value to the description of your command (ex. Bans the given player from the game)2. Now add values in your command that we just added "Inputs" folder (We support all values). If you want people to be able to choose players add a "StringValue" then add a "BooleanValue" and name it "PlayerValue" and then add another "BooleanValue" and name it "All" and set it to true if you want it to be able to choose "All"3. Go edit "AdminScript" in Workspace and add "Do Not Run" block and name it to your command name. Why? Because when executing the command it will execute the Do Not Run block with the same name.4. Now its time to script. Sent input from the gui will be a table so to get an input from the sent inputs you must use "Get Table Value" the key as the Input name (ex. Key: Player | Value: target). If you are using a PlayerValue Then create another Do Not Run block that will do the actual command (ex. BanPlrFromGame). For the first Do Not Run block get the player from the inputs and add a new "Set Variable" block below that and set the "VariableName" to "func" and set the value to the name of the second block. Confused? just copy one.Limitations:- Constantly sends information when input is changed which may cause lag so don't spam please- Sending information and loading the values are all server sided so if the server is slow then its gonna lag- Aspect ratio is poopy on other devices other than desktop- No "Others" option for PlayerValue- Expect bug

description: i'm prob not going to make anything on here all serious-like so i'll just dump unfinished works rq```basic quest systemcreate quests that will reward leaderstats on completion. could be modified to reward items and the likes but i didn't do that so go die.quests will be structured as so: (several example quests given in free model)----QuestName [folder]  Rewards [folder]    Leaderstats [folder]      LeaderStatName [NumberValue] [Value = reward given]  RequiredFlags [folder]     FirstFlag [BoolValue] [= false] [name = name of flag required to complete quest]     SecondFlag [BoolValue] [= false] [same deal^]     ...  FlagToActivate [StringValue] [= name of flag fired to assign quest to player]  Repeatable [BoolValue]  Description [folder]    FlavorText [StringValue] [value displays as quest body in gui]    ObjectiveText [StringValue] [same deal ^]    Sender [StringValue] [doubly same deal ^]----quests are basically trackers for flag strings sent to the Quests.fireFlag(player :Player, flagString :string) event. when a string is sent to the event, it'll check for quests where FlagToActivate.Value = flagString, and then assign them to the player.  it'll then check the RequiredFlags of any quest assigned to the player, and if requiredFlag.Name = flagString, it'll set its value to true.   if all requiredFlag.Value 's = true then quest is completable, firing remoteEvent questCompleted(player, quest), requiring the player's client to fire Quests.completeQuest (player :Player, currentQuest :Quest Folder) to fully complete it  when the quest is completed, it will fire Quest.fireFlag() with the player who completed it and the name of the quest, so a quest can be required to be completed for another quest or a quest can assign another quest as well.  calling Quests.savePlayerQuests(player) will save all of the player's quests to a data store so progress isn't lostetc etc.  running out of space here so just read the code plz```

creator: miguol
description: Mig's Program Maker**Mig's program maker, which is a text-based coding app, can be used to make programs such as importing objects, do repeating actions (it works slightly good), print, send messages and other functions!**--**Can the project/app be modified?***It is open-source, since it's aimed to players interested into how retrostudio coding works/how to create something like this will be able to learn :)*--**How does this work?**The program maker uses a script to read the lines inserted, run functions (it is also VERY case-sensitive) and finally, print an output.--**How good is it?**To be fair, in my persepective, I think it is great as it is an advancement from the kind of models you will find in here, there was a lot of effort put into this project.Performance-wise, I think it's low, due to Retrostudio's restrictions and just how Roblox handles client stuff bla bla bla. It's just a fun project so create your small programs, show it to the world and have fun! --**Note from the Creator:** If you ever import this app/plugin or whatever you'd like to name this, I would be really happy! As my goal for this is to prove text-based coding can be possible (this idea stemmed from an argument i saw on #retro-chat hehe)I'd also like to add that this program maker isn't the best but you can create functions in the main script and save programs which is already good :)Regarding add-ons, as I said earlier, you can add your own functions and have fun tweaking it! You can also republish this project of mine with your own edited version (you must credit me though :TrollSad: and I would allow a tweaked version if the changes made on the program maker are significant enough to be considered add-ons!)Thank you and I hope you enjoy using the first ever public model of text-based coding :) :Retweet:
